preconditions.description: The input root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.data <= 1000 for node in list(root))
preconditions.description: The data of each node must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output cloned_root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The cloned tree must be a separate instance from the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.data == cloned_node.data for node, cloned_node in zip(list(root), list(cloned_root)))
postconditions.description: The data of each node in the cloned tree must match the data of the corresponding node in the original tree.
